name: todo-api

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Stores each user's todos: text, completed state, and ownership.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's bearer token; the gateway injects the resolved caller identity.

description: Ballerina service owning the Todo entity: create a todo, list the caller's own todos, and mark one complete, always scoped to the authenticated caller. Does not support editing todo text or deleting a todo.
